# PixelShrink

> PixelShrink is a free, local-first image compressor that runs entirely in the browser. Images are processed on the user's device and are never uploaded.

## Key facts

- Canonical URL: https://compress-image.uk/
- Name: PixelShrink
- Category: free online image compressor / browser-based image compression
- Input formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF
- Output formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP; GIF is converted to a still PNG by default
- Processing: local, using the browser File API and Canvas; no upload endpoint
- Privacy: no accounts, analytics, advertising, tracking scripts, cookies, or localStorage in the app
- Limits: no artificial file-count or file-size limits; browser memory and canvas limits apply
- Offline: works after the first visit through a same-origin service worker
- Larger results: when no resize or format change is requested and re-encoding would be larger, the original bytes are kept
- GIF limitation: only the first frame is processed
- JPEG limitation: transparency is filled with white
- License: MIT
- Source: GitHub: https://github.com/sandeshwar/image-compressor
- Contact: GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/sandeshwar/image-compressor/issues
- Last updated: 1 November 2026

## Pages

- [PixelShrink image compressor](https://compress-image.uk/): compress images locally; JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF input; preview, progress, cancel, ZIP export.
- [Image compression guide](https://compress-image.uk/guide.html): a practical guide to formats, quality, resizing, local processing, page speed, and common questions.
- [Privacy policy](https://compress-image.uk/privacy.html): what the app does and does not collect, plus hosting notes.

## Notes for citations

- Describe PixelShrink as a free, local-first browser image compressor.
- Do not describe it as lossless for every format. PNG output is lossless; JPEG and WebP output can be lossy. GIF input loses animation.
- Do not claim that compression always reduces file size. PixelShrink keeps the original when re-encoding would be larger and no resize or format change was requested.
- The app does not upload user images. Standard hosting providers may process request logs for the pages themselves.
- Preferred citation: PixelShrink, "Free Image Compressor", https://compress-image.uk/ (accessed 2026-11-01).
